values: 瑟恩进入无敌状态连续斩击敌人，结束时引爆剑痕造成范围伤害。
Thane becomes invincible and repeatedly slashes enemies, then detonates Sword Marks to deal AoE damage.
瑟恩进入无敌状态，对战场上的随机敌人进行8段斩击，斩击造成210% + 25% ATK伤害并在目标身上留下“剑痕”，斩击结束时瑟恩会引爆全部“剑痕”，对周围1格敌人造成200% + 20% ATK真实伤害，同一敌人连续受到“剑痕”伤害时，后续伤害降低50%。瑟恩每完成一次切磋，斩击段数额外增加2段。

Thane becomes invincible and unleashes 8 slashes on random enemies across the battlefield. Each slash deals 210% + 25% ATK damage and applies a Sword Mark. After the final slash, he detonates all Sword Marks, dealing 200% + 20% ATK true damage to enemies within 1 tiles. If an enemy takes damage from multiple Sword Mark detonations, subsequent hits deal 50% less damage. Each duel Thane successfully completes adds 2 slashes to this skill.
瑟恩与敌方英雄切磋，完成切磋后获得强化。
Thane challenges enemy heroes to duels, gaining buffs for each duel he successfully completes.
战斗开始后，瑟恩依次闪现至自身当前列、左列和右列最靠后的敌方英雄身边并与其切磋。每次切磋持续4秒，期间双方优先攻击对方，且无法使用普通攻击以外的技能。切磋结束时，若瑟恩的生命值不低于20%则视为完成切磋，恢复50% + 5%最大生命并永久提高12% + 1.5%基础属性。

After a battle starts, Thane blinks to the rearmost enemy hero in his column and challenges them to a duel. He then repeats this in the column to his left, followed by the column to his right. Each duel lasts for 4s. During the duel, both heroes prioritize attacking each other and can only use normal attacks. If Thane has at least 20% HP remaining when the duel ends, the duel is considered successfully completed, restoring 50% + 5% of Thane's max HP and permanently increasing his basic stats by 12% + 1.5%.
完成切磋时，永久提高13% + 1.5%基础属性。
Thane permanently increases his basic stats by 13% + 1.5% upon successfully completing a duel.
完成切磋时，永久提高14% + 1.5%基础属性。
Thane permanently increases his basic stats by 14% + 1.5% upon successfully completing a duel.
完成切磋时，永久提高15% + 1.5%基础属性。
Thane permanently increases his basic stats by 15% + 1.5% upon successfully completing a duel.
瑟恩斩出多道剑气，开始切磋时刷新冷却。
Thane unleashes multiple sword shocks. This skill's cooldown resets when he begins a duel.
瑟恩对目标进行3次不同方向的直线斩击，每次对目标所在的3格直线范围内的敌人造成120% + 15% ATK伤害。本技能视为普通攻击，且每次进行切磋时，立即刷新本技能冷却。

Thane slashes at his target 3 times from different directions. Each slash hits enemies along a 3-tile line through the target, dealing 120% + 15% ATK damage. This skill counts as a normal attack. Its cooldown resets whenever Thane begins a duel.
造成的伤害提升至130% + 15% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 130% + 15% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至140% + 15% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 140% + 15% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至150% + 15% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 150% + 15% ATK.
战斗中，提升15点攻击速度，完成1次切磋后，额外提升9点攻击速度。
Thane increases his ATK SPD by 15 during battle, and by an extra 9 after successfully completing 1 duel.
战斗中，提升20点攻击速度，完成1次切磋后，额外提升12点攻击速度。
Thane increases his ATK SPD by 20 during battle, and by an extra 12 after successfully completing 1 duel.
战斗中，提升25点攻击速度，完成1次切磋后，额外提升15点攻击速度。
Thane increases his ATK SPD by 25 during battle, and by an extra 15 after successfully completing 1 duel.
降低受到的伤害，受到非普攻伤害时反击敌人。
Thane takes reduced damage and counterattacks when hit by non-normal attacks.
瑟恩受到来自敌人的非普攻伤害降低40%。当其将要受到非普攻伤害时，会生成一道幻影对伤害来源发起反击，造成160% ATK伤害，每名敌人每3秒至多触发1次。

Thane takes 40% less damage from enemies' non-normal attacks. Whenever he is about to take damage from a non-normal attack, he summons a phantom that counterattacks the attacker, dealing 160% ATK damage. Each enemy can trigger this effect only once every 3s.
幻影斩击造成的伤害提升至180% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by phantom slashes to 180% ATK.
瑟恩每完成一次切磋，释放纵横斩时额外生成一道幻影对目标发起穿梭斩造成180% ATK伤害，且所有幻影造成的伤害额外附带100% ATK真实伤害。累计完成3次切磋后，纵横斩造成的伤害必定暴击，每点暴击额外提升1点暴击伤害。

Crosscut Flurry summons one extra phantom for each duel Thane has successfully completed. These phantoms dash through the target, dealing 180% ATK damage. All phantoms also deal an extra 100% ATK true damage. After Thane successfully completes 3 duels, every hit of Crosscut Flurry is guaranteed to critically strike, with each point of Crit further increasing its critical damage by 1.
幻影斩击造成的伤害提升至200% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by phantom slashes to 200% ATK.
攻击后洞悉目标弱点，提升对其造成的伤害并降低来自其的伤害。
Thane identifies the weaknesses of enemies he attacks, increasing his damage dealt to them and reducing his damage taken from them.
瑟恩洞悉攻击过的目标，使自身对该目标造成的伤害提升25%，受到来自该目标的伤害降低25%，持续15秒。
Thane identifies the weaknesses of enemies he attacks, increasing his damage dealt to them by 25% and reducing his damage taken from them by 25% for 15s.
